title: You Didn't Turn On 1M Context
caption:
My context window quintupled and I didn't ask for it.

Claude Code 2.1.286, Sept 30: Opus 4.7+ and Fable now default to a 1M window on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and the Claude apps gateway, with no [1m] suffix. 2.1.285 did the same the day before for anything behind a custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.

What I had wrong: I thought the bigger window only cost me once I filled it. But Claude Code sends the whole conversation with every request, and it caps the auto-compact window at the model's context window. That cap was 200K. Compaction was doing my cost control for me, and its ceiling just moved.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1 puts it back. /autocompact 200k keeps the room and summarizes early — that's the one I picked.

Which one are you running?

slides.title: Put The Ceiling Back
items: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1 — a 200K window again, and sessions compact at that boundary.
/autocompact 200k — keeps the 1M room, summarizes at 200K. Saved per model since 2.1.288.
autoCompactWindow in settings.json — one window for every model, 100K to 1M.
